signatures.signature: pub fn create_unique(dir: &Path, name: impl FnMut() -> std::ffi::OsString) -> std::io::Result<(PathBuf, std::fs::File)>
signatures.doc: snipmd_core::atomic. Opens dir/<name()> with OpenOptions write+create_new; on AlreadyExists asks name() again, at most 64 attempts, then returns an AlreadyExists error. Any other error is returned at once. Never creates folders. atomic_write (R3, behaviour unchanged) takes its temp file from create_unique; create_snip (R4) takes the image file from it. No other create_new loop remains in the crate.

signatures.signature: pub fn snip_name(now: chrono::NaiveDateTime, rand4: u16, ext: &str) -> String; pub fn create_snip(dir: &Path, ext: &str, bytes: &[u8]) -> std::io::Result<PathBuf>; pub fn image_ext(p: &Path) -> Option<&'static str>
signatures.doc: snipmd_core::naming. snip_name: `snip-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS-mmm-XXXX.<ext>`, XXXX = rand4 as 4 lowercase hex digits, mmm the milliseconds. create_snip: names from snip_name(chrono::Local::now().naive_local(), rand::random(), ext) through create_unique, writes all bytes (no fsync), returns the path; when the write fails the new file is removed and the error returned. Never overwrites, never creates dir. image_ext: the lower-case extension when it is one of png, jpg, jpeg, gif, webp (case-insensitive), else None.

snipmd_core::links. Percent-encodes exactly space, (, ), # and % (as %20 %28 %29 %23 %25); every other character, `/` and non-ASCII included, stays. paths::resolve_image(dir, &encode_link_path(s)) == dir joined with s for any relative s without `..`. rewrite_prefix stays todo!() (phase 4).

signatures.signature: pub fn resolve_untitled(tab_dir: &Path, link: &str) -> Result<PathBuf, PathError>; pub fn valid_tab_id(id: &str) -> bool; pub fn percent_decode(s: &str) -> Result<String, PathError>; impl AllowedSet { pub fn allow_file(&mut self, p: &Path) }
signatures.doc: snipmd_core::paths. resolve_untitled: the same checks as resolve_image (reuse it, one lexical walk); the first resolved component must be exactly `untitled.assets` and at least one component must follow; the rest is joined onto tab_dir; anything else is PathError::NotAllowed or the resolve_image error. valid_tab_id: 1 to 64 chars of [A-Za-z0-9_-] (crypto.randomUUID ids pass; `..`, `/`, `\\`, `:` and empty fail). percent_decode: the existing private decoder made public, unchanged. allow_file: allows exactly that file (normalized like allow_note), no folder.

signatures.doc: src-tauri/src/lib.rs. SavedImage serializes as {link, absPath} (camelCase), matching src/types.ts. Image folder of a tab: a disk note (checked with check_path) uses <note folder>/<stem>.assets/, created with fs::create_dir (AlreadyExists is fine; a missing note folder is an error, never recreated), link = encode_link_path("<stem>.assets/<file>"); an untitled tab uses <app data>/scratch/<tab_id>/ (valid_tab_id or error; create_dir_all), link = "untitled.assets/<file>". save_image: body must be InvokeBody::Raw and non-empty; header x-tab-id required; header x-note-path optional, percent_decode'd (src/ipc.ts sends encodeURIComponent); create_snip(dir, "png", body). import_image: src must be in the dropped-images set (an AllowedSet filled with allow_file from drag-drop events, a second managed state) and have an image_ext; fs::read then create_snip with that extension. resolve_asset_abs_path: disk note as today; untitled tab: resolve_untitled(<app data>/scratch/<tab_id>, rel_path). save_session: body must be InvokeBody::Raw UTF-8; everything after that as today (allowed-set filter, atomic_write). files-dropped: emitted on every DragDrop::Drop with notes = .md/.markdown paths (allow_note as today), images = paths with image_ext (added to the dropped set), x/y = the drop position in physical pixels; other files are left out. Every returned path for display goes through displayable(). Errors name files with note_name.

signatures.signature: export function insertSnip(tabId: string, link: string, at?: number): void
signatures.doc: src/editor/paste.ts. Inserts `![snip](<link>)` on its own line below the line that holds `at` (default: the tab's cursor head), whether the tab is visible or not (getState + applyToTab). The text of that line is unchanged; no blank line is added; when the line is empty the link takes that line. The cursor moves to the start of the line after the link (a line break is added at the end of the document when needed). One transaction, scrolled into view.

signatures.doc: src/drop.ts. Notes open through openPaths(d.notes). Images go into the tab that was visible when the drop happened (its id read before anything else runs, since opening notes changes the visible tab): all importImage calls in parallel (allSettled), then the links are inserted in drop order with insertSnip, the first at the editor position under the drop point (getView().posAtCoords with x and y divided by window.devicePixelRatio; the tab's cursor when the tab is in read mode or the point is outside the text), each next one below the previous. Failed imports: one showError('add <names>', <first reason>). After any insert: scheduleSessionSave({ immediate: true }). Never resolves to an error.

units.task: Paste rules (SPEC §6.3) in src/editor/paste.ts. (1) T5 insertSnip exactly as the contract says. (2) The paste handler: when the clipboard has non-empty text/plain, return false so CodeMirror pastes the text (Excel, Word and browsers also put an image there; text wins). When Ctrl+Shift+V (Cmd on mac too) started this paste, never save an image: a keydown handler in the same extension notes it for the next paste event, any other keydown clears it. Otherwise take the first image/* item: read its bytes, saveImage(tabId, filePathFor(tabId), bytes), primeAssetCache(tabId, link, absPath), insertSnip(tabId, link) and scheduleSessionSave({ immediate: true }); on error showError('save the image', err). The tab id is read from the view's state when the paste starts, so a tab switch during the save inserts into the original tab. Tests in src/editor/paste.test.ts (jsdom; vi.mock '../ipc', '../session', '../infobar' and './imageWidget'; real registry and a real EditorView from createEditorState in './setup'; a paste event is a plain Event with a clipboardData object defined on it): text plus image pastes the text and never calls saveImage; image only saves once and inserts the link on its own line, the cursor on the line after; Ctrl+Shift+V with only an image saves nothing; a tab switch while saveImage is pending inserts into the original tab's state and leaves the visible tab unchanged; insertSnip cases: cursor mid-line (line text unchanged, link below), empty line, last line without a line break, `at` on another line.

checks.proves: text wins over an image; Ctrl+Shift+V never saves an image; a paste lands in the tab it started in; the link sits on its own line

units.limits: do not edit src/ipc.ts, src/types.ts, src/editor/registry.ts, src/editor/setup.ts or src/editor/imageWidget.ts; paste.ts under 100 lines

units.task: Inline images from the Markdown syntax tree in src/editor/imageWidget.ts, keeping every T7 signature. (1) build(): walk syntaxTree(state) and take every Image node (lang-markdown); the link target is its URL child (strip <...> brackets), the alt is the text inside ![...]; several images on one line give several block widgets at that line's end, in order; images inside fenced or inline code have no Image node and get no widget. No regex over lines. (2) The StateField rebuilds when the document changed, a redraw effect arrived, or syntaxTree(tr.state) !== syntaxTree(tr.startState) (the parser caught up); otherwise it maps. (3) Missing images: a failed resolveAssetPath is remembered per cache key (a set next to urlCache); the waiting tabs are redrawn once so the widget shows the placeholder `Image not found: `, and build() never starts a lookup for a key that failed (no retry loop); primeAssetCache clears a failure for its key. An error event shows the same placeholder. All text goes in with textContent. Keep the expand-on-click behaviour. Tests in src/editor/imageWidget.test.ts (jsdom; vi.mock '../ipc' with resolveAssetPath and toAssetUrl; real registry; states from createEditorState in './setup'; bindFilePathLookup for the note path): two images on one line give two widgets; an image in a fenced block and in inline code gives none; a failing lookup is called once, the widget becomes the not-found placeholder, and further document changes do not call resolveAssetPath again; two untitled tabs with the same link are looked up separately with their own tab ids; primeAssetCache makes a widget show the image without a lookup.

checks.proves: images come from the syntax tree (none in code); a missing image shows a placeholder and is looked up only once; untitled tabs do not share cache entries
